evidence.basis: the checkpoint selected by the frozen rule in training/tiny-transformer/GATES.md; parameters counted from the module (the tied readout once); gates measured by training/tiny-transformer/evaluate.py

g6.head: L2H2
g6.chosen_by: largest B-val share on the asked value, at the answer-writing position (ties: lowest layer, then head)
g6.measured_by: B-test first-character accuracy, the head zeroed at the answer-writing position only
